How to read this

  • Data captured 10:00 EDT July 26 with every Around-Long-Island boat resolved (45 finishers, 6 retired); the organizer still labels results preliminary. Nomad (Around-the-Islands course — a different course around Block Island) is out of scope and unscored.
  • Corrected times are division-scoped. PHRF divisions score time-on-distance at 207 nm; the new ORC Division 0 scores time-on-time. The two are never compared across the boundary.
  • Finish-time note: Max’s official finish was amended by the race committee to 11:57:18 — six seconds from her tracker’s line marker — after this project’s query. Three other boats’ official times still sit 8–68 minutes after their tracker line-crossings; official values are used throughout.

Sources & method

  • YB Tracking race alir26 (position history, decoded); YachtScoring event 50645 (entries, provisional results); Final 2026 ALIR SI (course, 207 nm, scoring).
  • Weather evidence: NDBC observations, NOAA CO-OPS current predictions, archived HRRR/ECMWF forecasts via Open-Meteo (CC-BY 4.0) — evidence for the narrative only; no chart number depends on it.
  • CROSS-SYSTEM METHODOLOGY (the internal comparison strip and any PHRF-vs-ORC read): no governing body sanctions a PHRF↔ORC conversion. Regional PHRF authorities publish time-on-time conversions of their OWN ratings (TCF = A/(B+PHRF), constants varying by region) and ORC’s ToD/ToT forms are internally equivalent (ToT ≈ 600/ToD) — but the ORC Triple-Number coefficient’s reference base is not published, so no cross-system corrected arithmetic is defensible. This dashboard therefore never converts: each boat is measured against her own scoring group’s winner (percent behind, corrected), and cross-group comparisons rest on the stated assumption that each group’s winner sailed comparably well. Internal analysis only; official standings remain per division.
